serverBlock.note: What a server answer states outright, beside the legacy flat fields it keeps. Every field is optional. A stated value wins over anything the parser would infer, and is then held to the invariants below: no combination of stated fields can advise an unsafe resend.

RETRY.meaning: Send the identical request again, after retry.afterSeconds when there is one.

RETRY_SAME_REQUEST.meaning: Send the identical request again under the same request id; the first answer is read back, never applied twice.

VERIFY_STATE.meaning: Read the resource the request was about. Reading is all this action does; whether anything is sent afterwards is the retry policy's to say, and on COMMITTED it says nothing is.

FIX_REQUEST.meaning: Change the request and send the changed one: as sent it is never accepted.

USE_NEW_REQUEST_ID.meaning: The request id already names a different request: send this one under a new id.

ANSWER_ADVICE.meaning: Answer the advice: change what it questions, or send the request again with the override it names.

AWAIT_OWNER_DECISION.meaning: A person has to decide first. Wait for that decision, then send the request again.

FILE_IN_OWN_PROJECT_OR_REQUEST_HANDOFF.meaning: Write into the caller's own project, or send the write again with a handoff declaration.

invariants.note: Applied after every field is resolved, stated or inferred, in this order, by both parsers (normalizeRecovery). hasRequestId = the client sent a request id, or resources names one of type requestIdResourceType. COMMITTED_IS_FINAL runs last and overrides everything before it.

then.retryPolicy: SAME_REQUEST_ID only if it was the policy and hasRequestId, else VERIFY_THEN_RETRY

then.actionCode: defaultActionByPolicy[retryPolicy], or AWAIT_OWNER_DECISION when userConfirmation is REQUIRED; none for COMMITTED or a 2xx
kept only if in readOnlyActionCodes, else null

holdsOnEveryEnvelope: effect COMMITTED => retryPolicy NEVER, afterSeconds null, and actionCode is null or an action whose mayWrite is false
effect UNKNOWN => retryPolicy in [VERIFY_THEN_RETRY, SAME_REQUEST_ID] and actionCode == defaultActionByPolicy[retryPolicy]
userConfirmation REQUIRED => retryPolicy not in [SAFE, SAME_REQUEST_ID] and actionCode is not an automaticRetry action
actionCode RETRY => retryPolicy SAFE; actionCode RETRY_SAME_REQUEST => retryPolicy SAME_REQUEST_ID

actionSemantics.automaticRetry: The action sends the identical request again with no change and no person in between.
actionSemantics.mayWrite: Carrying the action out can end in another write: a resend, a changed request, a request under a new id, or a request sent after a decision. false only for actions that read and nothing else.
actionSemantics.unregistered: An action token not in this registry is treated as automaticRetry false and mayWrite true.
